notes.title: Big Update - New Map and Hammerhead Shark
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8801494/9bc88c174fce0225622256eb6096710f98021741.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.36
notes.content:
Early Access: ver 1.0.36 [22 July, 2016]
---------------------------------------------
[IMPROVEMENTS]
[list]
[*] Improved quality of Voice Chat
[*] Improved network speed (when players are talking)
[*] Lots more performance improvements
[*] Added blood when knifing an enemy diver
[*] Added blood when knifing a shark
[*] The knife now does less damage (15 - 49% damage, and 2x damage for knifing the head)
[*] Slightly adjusted the speed between swipes with the knife (slightly slower)
[*] Predator Mode - Slightly reduced the amount of damage the Shark does in Predator mode
[*] Predator Mode - 100% Charged Bite Kill has been made 5% smaller, so you have to time it just right now
[*] Predator Mode - Reduced the game time to 15 minutes from 20 minutes
[/list]

[BUG FIXES]
[list]
[*] When chatting in the Menu the voice chat icon now shows
[*] Swimming Up/Down whilst sprinting and zoomed in would swim much faster than not zoomed in
[*] Fixed a bug where if you swiping with a knife and change weapons the knife would still show for a bit
[*] Fixed a bug where the Chat icon was incorrectly showing as disabled for yourself in the game Summary Screen
[/list]

Note:
Only players with the new version can play each other.
To force the update try restart steam.

notes.title: Added 4:3 and 5:4 Resolution support
notes.content:
Early Access: ver 1.0.29 [25th January, 2016]
-------------------------------------------------------------------

[NEW FEATURES]
- 5:4 Resolution Support Added
- 4:3 Resolution Support Added

- Predator mode health regeneration tweaked slightly again to balance the game a bit more

On certain resolutions in full-screen there are still issues with buttons not being clickable in the menu (they are clickable but you have to move the mouse to the left of them in order for the button to highlight and be clickable) This isn't a game bug but rather an engine bug, we are still waiting on the fix, if this happens to you please try a different resolution and if that doesn't help try window mode.

notes.title: PREDATOR MODE - update
notes.content:
This build addresses all known bugs with Predator Mode and makes a slight tweak to the health regeneration of the Shark when playing 1vs1 and also 1vs3.

[TWEAKS]
- Small tweaks to the Sharks health regeneration speed in Predator Mode to help balance the game a little more

[BUG FIXES]
- Predator Mode - Prevent Mako Shark selection from happening when typing a message
- Predator Mode - Fixed issue where the Diver & Shark killed each other at almost the exact same time then you could end up in a weird game state with 2 Sharks and one is an invisible shark to some players
- Predator Mode - Picking up the Health or Throwing Grenade just after killing the Shark would prevent you from biting when you become the Shark
- Predator Mode - Killing the Shark and then picking up Health or Throwing Flash grenade just before switching to Shark could cause you to have a Weapon instead of the Shark jaws
- Any game mode - Sometimes you could spawn without a weapon or ability to change weapons

NOTE!
You can only see and play players who are on this version of Shark Attack, 
if you don't immediately get the update try restart Steam.

notes.title: Predator Mode tweaks & bug fixes
notes.content:
thanks for the feedback, we've made some changes and the new build is now out:

[TWEAKS]
- Cannot swipe as fast with the knife anymore added a 0.1 second delay between swipes

[PREDATOR MODE CHANGES]
- Games are now 20 min instead of 30 min
- It now takes 4 seconds before health starts to regenerate (previously it was just 2 seconds)
- Health regeneration speed has been tweaked depending on number of players in the game (should make it more competitive for 2 player games)
- When a new player becomes the Shark everyone is notified who it is and the siren plays as well

[BUG FIXES]
- Predator Mode - Fixed an issue where under certain conditions you could bite a player even if they weren't nearby
- On the Results Screen the Remaining Time until returning to Lobby was only showing on Wrecks & Reefs, now shows on all maps

notes.title: Major update - Predator Mode (Play as Great White)
notes.content:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/352771657375321662/B126B0C0A3364BE6379DD0E6876F1DDC6E1D851D/?interpolation=lanczos-none&output-format=jpeg&output-quality=95&fit=inside|2048:1152&composite-to=*,*|2048:1152&background-color=black[/img]

Early Access: ver 1.0.25 [19th January, 2016]
--------------------------------------------------------------------

It's been a long wait.. but it's finally here, the new build of Shark Attack with the new Predator Mode which allows you to play as the Great White as well as control up to four Mako Sharks to send them to hunt selected divers or help defend you.

[NEW FEATURES]
- NEW GAME MODE - Predator Mode (Play as the shark vs 3 enemy divers)
- Sharks can now eat off body parts (legs & arms)
- Added contrast enhancer post processor effect
- We now supporting more resolutions (work in progress, let me know if there are any issues)
- Microphone is disabled by default
- By default the games doesn't anymore hi-jack your microphone from Steam Voice Chat with friends
- Press Y to toggle Microphone ON/OFF
- Press M to quickly Mute all players ON/OFF
- You can now enable/disable your voice chat from the Lobbies
- You can now mute/un-mute all players from the lobbies
- Added text to the lobbie screens to show what to press to mute or enable voice chat
- Switched the Zoom & Sprint buttons on the Joystick, to sprint you now hold left trigger (much easier on the thumbs), Press down on the Left Thumbstick to Zoom
- In-Game Options Menu - Graphics Quality settings visual effects are now enabled/disabled in realtime instead of on next level loading
- Updated Loading screens to use new logo
- Updated initial Game Setup image to use the new Shark Attack Logo
- Performance improvements

[BUG FIXES]
- HIGH PRIORITY BUG that caused players under certain conditions to be invincible (in both Deathmatch and Shark Mode)
- When trying to Host a game if there was an error and you clicked Retry it wouldn't actually retry
- When trying to Host a game if there was an error and you clicked Back it would take you to an empty menu
- The Map Name under Available Sessions wasn't always showing the correct name
- Fixed issues & improved performance around switching between different types of lobbies
- Quick Settings wasn't always clickable in the Options Menu in Survival
- If the Predator Summary screen is showing and you press ESC it now auto hides the Summary Screen
- If you viewed Summary Screen and then closed it and then tried to open the In Game Options screen some of the options weren't clickable
- Inverted mouse now works correctly when zooming
- Many other bug fixes & tweaks

Let us know if you find any issues, it's a a big update from our side which has affected almost every part of the game so there might be a few issues here and there.

Enjoy

notes.title: Predator Mode - Play as the Shark ( development update)
notes.content:
[b]Development Update[/b]
Predator Mode is almost complete and we have progressed into our internal testing phase.We are on track to release a closed beta to a select few players within the next 2 weeks before we open up the beta to everyone else.We appreciate everyone's patience as we have been working flat out to bring you guys this massive update.

An Overview of Predator Mode.
Players will finally get a chance to play from the perspective of the Great White Shark. Its a Player vs Player Game mode, A player takes on the role as the Shark and hunts down the other divers, the other divers can either work together or against to bring down the Great White. Who ever brings down the Predator takes on the role and so the hunt continues.

A really exciting stand out feature that we have not revealed until now is that the Predator player has 4 Mako's that they are able to command. They can either be used to defend yourself with or send off to attack the other divers ( this really helps flush out divers who are hiding in places the Great White cant get into).

We cant wait for all you guys to experience what its like to be one of the oceans top apex Predators, the feeling of power and knowing how much terror you can cause is awesome .

notes.title: New Options Screen, Configurable Keys & Improved Xbox Controller support
notes.content:
Build 1.0.5 - 11th June 2015
------------------------------------------

[NEW FEATURES]
- Re-designed Options screen 
- Ability to re-configure Keyboard & Joystick buttons
- Faster & more reliable save/load system
- Fully support both Xbox One and Xbox 360 controllers
- Joystick Rumble support (Xbox One & Xbox 360 controllers)
- Hot-switch between Controller & Keyboard/Mouse during gameplay without having to change any settings (and rumble will only when you using the Controller as expected)
- You can now switch between Graphics Quality Settings from within the game
- Added ability to configure VSync (Don't sync, Every VBlank, and Every Second VBlank)
- New chat spam prevention system to limit chat spam abuse

[TWEAKS]
- Small tweaks to HUD messages to make it easier to see what Key to use to Pickup or Throw etc.
- Quick Join will now join a lobby if one exists (previously it ignored players waiting in lobbies)

[BUG FIXES]
- Fixed an issue where Joining a session where nobody votes for a map could cause major issues for the Network Session (invisible players etc.)
- Tsunami bug fixes with UV Textures & missing collision boxes

notes.title: Fixed Screen Resolution issues - [ver 1.0.3 - 2nd June 2015]
notes.content:
[New Features]
- Added support for 16x10 screen resolutions

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed issues some players were having with the UI (user interface) not showing correctly (either off-screen or on top of each other) Also fixes the issue with the Black Letter Box bars not displaying in the correct position for these players.

[Known Issues]
- If your screen is at a certain resolution (for example 1280x720) and you set the game to 1280x720 full-screen you may have issues clicking on buttons in the menu (the hit zone may be off). 
This is an bug with Unity (the engine we use for game), I've logged a case with them and hope they will fix it soon.

If you have this problem, please try a different resolution until you find one that works, or else you will need to play in Window Mode.


Tomorrow we looking to add support configure the Keyboard buttons (which is a bit of an issue for people who don't have English layout keyboards)
